children: RNS Number : 6804S  Bytes Technology Group PLC  01 September 2026
Notification of admission of further securities to trading

In accordance with PRM 1.6.4R, BTG announces that it has issued and allotted the following ordinary shares of £0.01 each in connection with the Company's share plans. These shares have been admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market under an existing block admission.
Details of the transferable securities admitted to trading
Total number of securities in issue following admission
230,400,683 (following cancellation of the ordinary shares purchased under the Company's share repurchase programme announced on 12 May 2026)
Confirmation that the shares are fungible with existing ordinary shares
The Company has a primary listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and a secondary
listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
